physical_ceiling_notes.rtx_pro_5000_decode_short: 384-bit GDDR7 (1,227.6 GB/s measured 1 GiB uint4 streaming ceiling); Speed-Max (LEANSONIC_ATTN_Q8_16=0) reaches 220.8-221.0 tok/s Solo / 313.5 tok/s Spec, while default v0.11.0 32GB+ Precision-Max (W_q8_16 x X_2term, #35/#235) clears 100-chunk kld_mean = 0.002989 <= 0.0030 (full 24L: 0.002956, max_kld -52.4%) at 215.8 tok/s Solo and 1,580.4 tok/s C=64.
physical_ceiling_notes.rtx_pro_5000_spec_avg: v0.11.0 DFlash 2 Q4 MLP/o_proj/lm_head drafter + fast register Top-16 selector (#237/#241) reaches 313.5-313.9 tok/s (struct peak 352.9 tok/s) on Speed-Max and 296.4 tok/s on 32GB+ Precision-Max.
physical_ceiling_notes.rtx_pro_4500_200w_cap: nvidia-smi dmon under 100% SM prefill confirms hard 200.00 W VBIOS cap (86 C, 2,242-2,355 MHz across 80 SMs) vs RTX PRO 5000 (348 W, 56 C, 2,531 MHz across 110 SMs). v0.11.0 reaches 10,398.6 tok/s @2K, 9,703.6 tok/s @16K, 6,344.6 tok/s @128K, 166.5 tok/s Solo, 1,179.2 tok/s C=64, and kld_mean = 0.002989 PASS.
physical_ceiling_notes.rtx_5070_ti_and_5060_ti_spill: v0.11.0 2-Tier Hardware Pack Split (LEANSONIC_PACK=auto, #231/#235/#236/#241/#246) auto-selects the 12.49 GiB 16GB Target Pack (lossless rank embedding + MXFP8 block-scale codes + 2-bit ternary down), fitting all 24/24 MoE layers + DFlash 2 Q4 in 14.38-15.25 GiB GDDR7 (0 PCIe spill!): RTX 5070 Ti jumps to 10,222 tok/s @2K (+47%), 176.7 tok/s Solo (+46%), 235.9 tok/s Spec (2.05x v0.10.0), and 394.1 tok/s C=4; RTX 5060 Ti Gen4 x4 jumps to 4,887 tok/s @2K (+64%), 99.9 tok/s Solo (1.96x), 135.0 tok/s Spec (2.50x v0.10.0, 4.09x Basalt), and 225.6 tok/s C=4.
